description: SCHC Rule Versioning test vectors per spec section 5.7. Covers DIO Rule Version Option serialization/parsing, Rule 255 uncompressed fallback, version mismatch scenarios, and decompression failure cases.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_option_v0
vectors.description: DIO Rule Version Option with reserved version 0; it never activates an operational fallback registry.
vectors.provenance: Version 0 is reserved per spec section 5.7. Rule 255 syntax is version-independent under its narrow policy, but does not make version 0 operational; Type=0x13 is SCHC_RULE_VERSION_TYPE.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_option_v1
vectors.description: DIO Rule Version Option with version 1 (legacy experimental, not interoperable).
vectors.provenance: Version 1 is legacy experimental per spec section 5.7 table.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_option_v2
vectors.description: DIO Rule Version Option with version 2 (legacy pre-canonical Rule 7 profile).
vectors.provenance: Version 2 predates the canonical specialized Rule 7 residue.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_option_v3
vectors.description: DIO Rule Version Option with version 3 (current canonical Rule 7 profile).
vectors.provenance: Version 3 is current and includes the canonical specialized Rule 7 residue.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_option_v127
vectors.description: DIO Rule Version Option with version 127 (mid-range boundary).
vectors.provenance: 8-bit unsigned version field; 127 is mid-range boundary.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_option_v255
vectors.description: DIO Rule Version Option with version 255 (maximum 8-bit value).
vectors.provenance: 8-bit unsigned version field allows 0-255; 255 is maximum.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_parse_truncated_2byte
vectors.description: Parsing Rule Version Option with only 2 bytes must fail (needs 3).
vectors.provenance: Wire format requires 3 bytes: Type(1B) + Length(1B) + Version(1B).

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_parse_truncated_1byte
vectors.description: Parsing Rule Version Option with only 1 byte must fail.
vectors.provenance: Wire format requires 3 bytes minimum.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_parse_wrong_type
vectors.description: Parsing with wrong option type 0x12 must fail.
vectors.provenance: Expected Type=0x13; 0x12 is different option type.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_parse_wrong_length
vectors.description: Parsing with length field != 1 must fail.
vectors.provenance: Length field must be exactly 1 for SchcRuleVersionOption.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_parse_trailing_bytes
vectors.description: A fixed three-byte option must reject trailing bytes rather than consume another TLV.
vectors.provenance: The parser returns no consumed length, so its input must be exactly one canonical option.

vectors.name: dio_rule_version_parse_length_0
vectors.description: A complete Type 0x13, Length 0 TLV is rejected because the SCHC Rule Version value length must be exactly one.
vectors.provenance: The TLV is structurally complete at two bytes, but Length 0 violates the option's required Length 1.

vectors.name: version_compatible_v3_v3
vectors.description: Current version 3 peers are compatible.
vectors.provenance: Same current versions are compatible per spec section 5.7.

vectors.name: version_compatible_v2_v2
vectors.description: Legacy version 2 is not operational without an immutable version-2 registry.
vectors.provenance: This implementation ships only the immutable Version 3 registry.

vectors.name: version_compatible_v0_v0
vectors.description: Reserved version 0 is never operationally compatible.
vectors.provenance: Version 0 is reserved and cannot identify a compression registry.

vectors.name: version_compatible_v255_v255
vectors.description: Undefined future version 255 is not operationally compatible.
vectors.provenance: Equality cannot activate a rule registry that is not implemented.

vectors.name: version_mismatch_v1_v2
vectors.description: Version 1 and legacy version 2 are incompatible.
vectors.provenance: Different versions are incompatible per spec section 5.7.

vectors.name: version_mismatch_v2_v1
vectors.description: Legacy version 2 and version 1 are incompatible.
vectors.provenance: Mismatch regardless of which side is higher.

vectors.name: version_mismatch_v2_v3
vectors.description: Legacy version 2 and current version 3 are incompatible.
vectors.provenance: Future versions require matching; no forward compatibility.

vectors.name: version_mismatch_v0_v2
vectors.description: Version 0 (reserved) and legacy version 2 are incompatible.
vectors.provenance: Reserved version 0 not interoperable with production versions.

vectors.name: version_mismatch_v254_v255
vectors.description: Adjacent high versions 254 and 255 are incompatible.
vectors.provenance: Versions must match exactly; no range compatibility.

vectors.name: rule255_fallback_min_ipv6
vectors.description: Rule 255 fallback with minimal 40-byte IPv6 header only.
vectors.provenance: A zero-payload IPv6 packet uses Next Header 59 (No Next Header); its 40-byte header plus the Rule 255 prefix is 41 bytes.

vectors.name: rule255_fallback_ipv6_udp_8byte_payload
vectors.description: Rule 255 fallback with IPv6+UDP+8-byte payload.
vectors.provenance: 40-byte IPv6 + 8-byte UDP + 8-byte payload + 1-byte prefix = 57 bytes.

vectors.name: rule255_fallback_max_single_frame
vectors.description: Rule 255 with a raw IPv6 packet at the exact signed Extended-unicast single-frame limit.
vectors.provenance: A 255-byte frame leaves 186 L2 payload bytes after fixed fields, Extended DST, mandatory SIID, and Schnorr-48; dispatch consumes one and Rule 255 consumes one, leaving 184 IPv6 bytes.

vectors.name: rule255_version_mismatch_fallback
vectors.description: Outside an incompatible DODAG, an authenticated peer registry may use Rule 255 fallback for one unfragmented packet.
vectors.provenance: Rule 255 is a narrowly scoped authenticated-peer fallback and cannot bypass DODAG admission.

vectors.name: decompression_failure_empty_packet
vectors.description: Empty SCHC packet must raise error, not crash.
vectors.provenance: Zero-length input must produce clean error.

vectors.name: decompression_failure_unknown_rule_8
vectors.description: Rule ID 8 (first gap after defined Rules 0-7) must raise unknown_rule_id.
vectors.provenance: Rules 8-63 are undefined gaps; must reject cleanly.

vectors.name: decompression_failure_unknown_rule_63
vectors.description: Rule ID 63 is outside the Version 3 wire registry and must raise unknown_rule_id.
vectors.provenance: Rule 63 is an undefined wire ID; Python helper IDs 64-66 are descriptor components, not a following wire-ID range.

vectors.name: decompression_failure_unknown_rule_67
vectors.description: Rule ID 67 is outside the Version 3 wire registry and must raise unknown_rule_id.
vectors.provenance: Rule 67 is an undefined wire ID; local descriptor helpers 64-66 do not establish a wire-ID allocation.

vectors.name: decompression_failure_unknown_rule_119
vectors.description: Rule ID 119 (just before fragmentation) must raise unknown_rule_id.
vectors.provenance: Rule 119 undefined; fragmentation starts at 120.

vectors.name: decompression_failure_unknown_rule_254
vectors.description: Rule ID 254 (just before 255) must raise unknown_rule_id.
vectors.provenance: Rule 254 undefined; 255 is uncompressed fallback.

vectors.name: decompression_failure_truncated_rule0
vectors.description: Rule 0 packet truncated at 5 bytes (needs 23+ for residue).
vectors.provenance: Rule 0 requires 22-byte residue + 1-byte ID; 5 bytes is truncated.

vectors.name: decompression_failure_helper_rule66_not_wire
vectors.description: Helper descriptor ID 66 is not a Version 3 wire Rule ID and must be rejected before residue decoding.
vectors.provenance: The ICMPv6-Echo helper Rule object numbered 66 composes whole-packet Rule 2; default contexts never select or decode 66 on wire.

vectors.name: decompression_failure_ipv6_invalid_version
vectors.description: Decompressed IPv6 with invalid version nibble must fail.
vectors.provenance: Spec section 5.7: decompression producing invalid IPv6 must drop packet.

vectors.name: rule_set_v3_registry_fingerprint
vectors.description: Canonical Version 3 generic descriptor membership, lookup, deterministic selection, and fingerprint; specialized wire Rule 7 is tested through the packet codec.
vectors.provenance: FNV-1a-64 covers only the generic descriptor registry. Rule 7 is the canonical specialized codec path; Rules 64-66 are non-wire helper descriptors.

vectors.name: repeated_failures_version_mismatch_detection
vectors.description: Repeated decompression failures from same source suggests version mismatch.
vectors.provenance: Per spec section 5.7 table: repeated failures trigger mismatch notification.

vectors.name: failure_tracker_capacity_fails_closed_without_eviction
vectors.description: A full authenticated-source tracker rejects a new signer and preserves the existing consecutive-failure run.
vectors.provenance: Bounded implementations fail closed rather than evicting an authenticated signer whose consecutive-failure run is security-relevant.

vectors.name: dio_dodag_filter_version_match
vectors.description: Node joins DODAG when DIO version matches local version.
vectors.provenance: Per spec section 5.7: nodes MUST join or remain only in a DODAG advertising the authenticated supported version.

vectors.name: dio_dodag_filter_version_mismatch
vectors.description: Node does not join DODAG when DIO version mismatches local.
vectors.provenance: Per spec section 5.7: version mismatch indicates firmware incompatibility.

vectors.name: fragmentation_requires_version_match
vectors.description: Directional fragmentation Rules 0x78 and 0x79 require a matching rule-set version; 0x7A through 0xFE remain reserved.
vectors.provenance: Per spec section 5.7: Rule 255 does not provide fragmentation compatibility, and Version 3 assigns only 0x78/0x79 to fragmentation.

vectors.name: rule255_no_fragmentation
vectors.description: Rule 255 packet exceeding single frame cannot fragment without version match.
vectors.provenance: Per spec section 5.7: Rule 255 does not provide fragmentation compatibility.

admission_policy_vectors.name: rule255_mismatch_inside_dodag_rejected
admission_policy_vectors.description: A sender advertising an incompatible root-originated rule version cannot use Rule 255 to join or exchange operational traffic inside that DODAG.
admission_policy_vectors.provenance: Rule 255 support does not weaken the authenticated DODAG rule-version admission boundary.

admission_policy_vectors.name: non_root_propagates_root_version_unchanged
admission_policy_vectors.description: Every authenticated parent-selectable non-root DIO propagates the root-originated version byte exactly.
admission_policy_vectors.provenance: A non-root cannot substitute its local version or omit the root's version while remaining parent-selectable.

admission_policy_vectors.name: non_root_version_substitution_rejected
admission_policy_vectors.description: A validly signed non-root DIO that substitutes another rule version is not a parent candidate.
admission_policy_vectors.provenance: Hop authentication does not authorize changing a root-scoped compatibility value.

admission_policy_vectors.name: parent_selectable_dio_missing_version_rejected
admission_policy_vectors.description: An authenticated DIO without exactly one rule-version option cannot be parent-selectable.
admission_policy_vectors.provenance: Exact propagation requires one canonical Type 0x13/Length 1 option on every parent-selectable DIO.
